conditions: This is evaluation of an individual Filter operator on an input multiset. A condition has a final true or false effective boolean value or produces an error.
limitations: An error in part of an expression can be masked by a logical operator. This claim covers the final result used by Filter and does not predict an enclosing OPTIONAL result or query-wide error behavior.

triggers: Issuer erratum, changed source representation, or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: At a SPARQL 1.1 algebraic Filter, an input mapping survives with its input multiplicity when the effective boolean value of the condition is true. A false effective boolean value or condition evaluation error eliminates that mapping at this operator.
